episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overviewEn: Detective James Gordon performs his work in the dangerously corrupt city of Gotham, which consistently teeters between good and evil.
episodes.overviewAr: يحقق المخبر الجديد "جيمس غوردون" وشريكه المحنك "هارفي بولوك" في مقتل والدي الملياردير "بروس وين" البالغ من العمر 12 عامًا.

episodes.name: Selina Kyle
episodes.overviewEn: Detectives Gordon and Bullock investigate a child trafficking ring preying on Gotham's street kids, including Selina Kyle. Meanwhile, Penguin resurfaces in the countryside and begins to make his way back to Gotham.
episodes.overviewAr: يتحرى "غوردون" و"بولوك" عن عصابة للاتجار بالأطفال تصطاد أطفال الشوارع بما في ذلك "سيلينا"، ويبدأ "البطريق" طريق العودة إلى "غوثام".

episodes.name: The Balloonman
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock track down a vigilante who uses weather balloons to kill corrupt citizens; Cobblepot gets a job close to a major figure in the underworld.
episodes.overviewAr: يتتبع المحققان "غوردون" و"بولوك" شخصًا ينتقم من المواطنين الفاسدين في "غوثام" عن طريق ربطهم في بالونات الطقس.

episodes.name: Arkham
episodes.overviewEn: As a contentious city council vote on the future of the Arkham district approaches, politicians from both sides are in danger. Gordon and Bullock must race to protect the council and an old friend visits Gordon.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يصوت مجلس المدينة المتنازع على الخطط الخاصة بمنطقة "أركام"، يتعرض السياسيون من الجانبين للخطر.

episodes.name: Viper
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock search for the source of a new street drug that causes euphoria then death. Oswald Cobblepot works his way deeper into Maroni's inner circle. Fish Mooney continues to plot against Falcone.
episodes.overviewAr: يبحث "غوردون" و"بولوك" عن مصدر المخدّر الجديد الذي يسبب النشوة ثم الوفاة؛ ويتعمّق "كوبلبوت" بطريقته ليتقرب من "ماروني".

episodes.name: Spirit of the Goat
episodes.overviewEn: When a killer begins targeting the first born of Gotham's elite, Bullock is forced to confront traumatic memories from a nearly identical case he worked in the past. Gordon is confronted by past decisions.
episodes.overviewAr: يبدأ قاتل في استهداف أول مولود من أبناء النخبة في "غوثام"، ويواجه "بولوك" ذكريات مأساوية لقضية متطابقة تقريبًا عمل عليها في الماضي.

episodes.name: Penguin's Umbrella
episodes.overviewEn: As violence between Maroni and Falcone continues to escalate, Penguin reveals a new element of his manipulative strategy, forcing Gordon to deal with the consequences of his decision to spare Penguin’s life
episodes.overviewAr: يكشف "البطريق" عنصرًا جديدًا من استراتيجيته الماكرة، ويضطر "غوردون" للتعامل مع العواقب المترتبة على قراره بالحفاظ على حياة "البطريق".

episodes.name: The Mask
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock investigate a Gothamite who runs a deadly fight club for candidates applying to work at his financial firm. Bruce returns to school and gets a visit from a new friend.
episodes.overviewAr: عند العثور على "غوثامي" مضروبًا حتى الموت يثير الدافع اهتمام "غوردون" و"بولوك"، ويعود "بروس" إلى المدرسة ويواجه صعوبة في تكوين صداقات.

episodes.name: Harvey Dent
episodes.overviewEn: Trying to close the Wayne murder case, a young Harvey Dent and Gordon team up, much to Mayor James’ chagrin. Meanwhile, Penguin makes contact with Mooney’s secret weapon, Liza.
episodes.overviewAr: لإغلاق قضية قتل "وين" يحث "هارفي دينت" الشاب "غوردون" للاتحاد مع العمدة "جيمس" ويتصل "البطريق" بـ "لايزا": سلاح "موني" السري.

episodes.name: Lovecraft
episodes.overviewEn: Following a misstep, Gordon is reassigned to duty at Arkham Asylum. Meanwhile, Selina leads a new friend on a perilous journey through Gotham to evade the assassins after her.
episodes.overviewAr: تقود "سيلينا" صديقًا جديدًا في رحلة محفوفة بالمخاطر عبر "غوثام" للتهرب من القتلة الذين يطاردونها؛ يُعاد تعيين "غوردون" بعد تعثره.

episodes.name: Rogues' Gallery
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon’s assignment at Arkham Asylum gets off to a rocky start when the murder of a guard ignites an investigation, leading him to meet Dr. Leslie Thompkins. Cobblepot continues to build his army.
episodes.overviewAr: تبدأ مهمة "غوردون" في مصحة "أركام" بداية صعبة، حيث يثير مقتل أحد الحراس تحقيقًا يقوده إلى "د. ليزلي تومكينز".

episodes.name: What the Little Bird Told Him
episodes.overviewEn: In an attempt to get his job back, Gordon seeks to capture Jack Gruber, a deranged electrical genius who escapes Arkham Asylum. Meanwhile, Falcone struggles to hold onto his empire after Fish Mooney makes her next move.
episodes.overviewAr: في محاولة لاستعادة وظيفته يسعى "غوردن" إلى العثور على "جاك غروبر" وهو عبقري مشوش متخصص في الكهرباء هارب من مصحة "أركام".

episodes.name: Welcome Back, Jim Gordon
episodes.overviewEn: When the key witness in a homicide ends up dead while being held for questioning by the police, Gordon suspects that it’s an inside job and looks to an old friend for information. Meanwhile, Oswald Cobblepot takes control of one of Fish Mooney’s prized possessions, as she gets a gets a small taste of her own medicine.
episodes.overviewAr: عندما يُقتل الشاهد الرئيسي في جريمة قتل أثناء حجزه يشتبه "غوردون" في عناصر من الداخل ويسعى للحصول على معلومات من صديق قديم.

episodes.name: The Fearsome Dr. Crane
episodes.overviewEn: Fish Mooney reveals a secret of Oswald Cobblepot's, prompting Maroni to take him on a trip to test his loyalty. Meanwhile, Gordon and Bullock hunt down a killer who targets victims with severe phobias and Bruce Wayne confronts Gordon for failing to make progress on his parents' murder case.
episodes.overviewAr: تكشف "فيش" عن سر "أوزوالد كوبلبوت"، مما يستدعي اختبارًا لولاء "ماروني"؛ يتتبع "غوردون" و"بولوك" قاتلاً يستهدف الضحايا بمرض الرهاب.

episodes.name: The Scarecrow
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock set out to stop Gerald Crane, a biology teacher who has been harvesting the glands of his murder victims. Meanwhile, after finding herself in an unusual setting, Mooney continues plotting to gain power, and Falcone attempts to change Maroni's plan for the Penguin.
episodes.overviewAr: يهدف "غوردون" و"بولوك" إلى وقف مدرس أحياء يجمع غدد ضحاياه بعد قتلهم؛ تتابع "موني" التآمر للوصول إلى السلطة.

episodes.name: The Blind Fortune Teller
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon takes Dr. Leslie Thompkins to the circus, but the day turns quickly when the circus comes under attack. Then, Falcone enlists Butch Gilzean to help Penguin with the nightclub, while Fish Mooney is otherwise occupied. Also, Bruce Wayne schedules a meeting with the Wayne Enterprises board.
episodes.overviewAr: يصطحب "غوردون" "دكتور ليزلي ثومبكنز" إلى السيرك ولكن السيرك يتعرض لهجوم. يطلب "فالكون" من "بوتش غيلزين" مساعدة "البطريق" في الملهى.

episodes.name: Red Hood
episodes.overviewEn: Following several bank robberies, Gordon and Bullock investigate the Red Hood gang. Selina Kyle continues to bond with Barbara, and Fish Mooney tries to reclaim her position in the underworld.
episodes.overviewAr: تقع عدة عمليات سطو على البنوك فيتحرى "غوردون" و"بولوك" عن "عصابة القلنسوة الحمراء" وتواصل "سيلينا كايل" علاقتها مع "باربرا".

episodes.name: Everyone Has a Cobblepot
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon seeks information about the controversy involving Loeb; Fish's allegiance with the prisoners is questioned; and Bruce copes with the aftermath of an attack close to home.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يبحث "غوردون" عن معلومات حول الجدل الأخير مع رئيس الشرطة "لوب" يصبح ولاء "فيش" للسجناء مثار تساؤل.

episodes.name: Beasts of Prey
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock inspect a cold case involving "the Ogre", a serial killer who targets young women in Gotham City. Meanwhile, Fish plots her escape from the Dollmaker, and Bruce and Selina confront Reggie.
episodes.overviewAr: يحقق "غوردون" و"بولوك" في قضية صعبة حول قاتل متسلسل يستهدف الشابات في مدينة "غوثام"؛ تخطط "فيش" للهرب من "صانع الدمى".

episodes.name: Under the Knife
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock continue their investigation of the Ogre, who begins to make his move on someone close to Gordon. Meanwhile, Bruce and Selina team up to expose a corrupt Wayne Enterprises employee and Nygma comes to Kristin Kringle’s defense.
episodes.overviewAr: يواصل "غوردون" و"بولوك" تحريهما عن "الغول" الذي يدبر أمرًا تجاه شخص قريب من "غوردون" ويفضح "بروس" و"سيلينا" فساد إحدى "مؤسسات وين".

episodes.name: The Anvil or the Hammer
episodes.overviewEn: The Ogre breaks down Barbara’s emotions, while Gordon and Bullock go to great lengths to track him down. Meanwhile, Penguin leads a massacre, beginning an epic war, while Bruce learns the truth about Wayne Enterprises and Nygma deals with his recent actions.
episodes.overviewAr: يخذل "الغول" "باربرا" عاطفيًا حيث يبذل "غوردون" و"بولوك" جهدًا كبيرًا للقبض عليه؛ يقود "البطريق" المذبحة، لتبدأ ملحمة الحرب.

episodes.name: All Happy Families Are Alike
episodes.overviewEn: As Gotham City’s gang war reaches its boiling point, Fish Mooney goes head-to-head with Maroni and Penguin in an attempt to re-stake her claim on the city. Meanwhile, Barbara and Leslie Thompkins are brought together after recent events, and Bruce searches Wayne Manor for any hints that his father might have left behind.
episodes.overviewAr: تصل حرب العصابات في مدينة "غوثام" لدرجة الغليان وتتعاون "فيش موني" مع "ماروني" و"البطريق" في محاولة لاستعادة المدينة.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Damned If You Do...
episodes.overviewEn: Penguin is King of Gotham and after a shakeup at the GCPD, Detective James Gordon's moral compass wavers, as he seeks help from Penguin. Meanwhile, Bruce Wayne continues to explore the secrets from his father's office, and Gotham newcomers Theo Galavan and his sister, Tabitha, make friends with some unlikely allies - a group of dangerous inmates from Arkham.
episodes.overviewAr: يقيم "غوردون" على مضض علاقة شراكة مع "أوزوالد كوبلبوت"، بينما يعرف "بروس" المزيد عن أسرار والده الراحل.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Knock, Knock
episodes.overviewEn: On the heels of his reinstatement, Gordon is thrust onto the high-profile case tracking the deadly inmate escape from Arkham Asylum. Meanwhile, Galavan plans his next move, while Bruce asks for help from his father's old friend to unlock the secrets in his office, and Nygma asks out Kristin Kringle on a date.
episodes.overviewAr: يقود "غوردون" الفرقة للعثور على الهاربين من مصحة "أركام" والذين مازالوا طلقاء، في حين يتخذ "ألفريد" إجراءات صارمة لحماية "بروس".

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: The Last Laugh
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock track down a nemesis from the past, leading to a standoff between Jerome and Gordon. Meanwhile, a magic show at the Gotham Children's Hospital gala turns into a hostage situation.
episodes.overviewAr: يُقنع "ألفريد" "بروس" بحضور حفل خيري لصالح مستشفًى للأطفال، لكن تنقلب الأمور وتأخذ منحًى شريرًا في نهاية الأمسية.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Strike Force
episodes.overviewEn: Captain Barnes is called to duty to create a law-abiding task force, with the help of Gordon. Meanwhile, Penguin gets caught up in a favor for Galavan, and Nygma asks Kringle out on a date.
episodes.overviewAr: حادث مأساوي في قسم الشرطة يؤدي إلى ترقية "غوردون" وتجديد الالتزام بمكافحة قوى الشر، بينما يرسم "ثيو غالافان" خطته لمستقبل "غوثام".

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Scarification
episodes.overviewEn: Galavan and Penguin join forces with a dangerous family in Gotham. Then, as the rivalry between the Waynes and the Galavans resurfaces, Gordon struggles to maintain order in the city.
episodes.overviewAr: تضرب الجريمة "غوثام" عندما يتحالف "البطريق" و"غالافان" مع عائلة من المخربين، ويطفو على السطح عداء قديم بين آل "غالافان" وآل "وين".

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: By Fire
episodes.overviewEn: After Bridgit Pike rejoins her brothers, a new spark of courage ignites within her, as she chooses to take control of her future. Meanwhile, Kringle and Nygma's relationship will take a new step and Penguin and Galavan continue to battle for control of Gotham City's underworld.
episodes.overviewAr: تدرس "بريدجيت" المضطربة خياراتها المتاحة، بينما يواصل "البطريق" و"غالافان" تبارزهما المحموم لتسلّق سلّم السلطة.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Mommy's Little Monster
episodes.overviewEn: Butch leads Penguin and his men to the warehouse where Gertrude is being held, as Penguin plots his revenge on Galavan for kidnapping his mother. Meanwhile, Nygma deals with the aftermath of a deadly accident.
episodes.overviewAr: يصمم "البطريق"، الذي تسيطر عليه فكرة الانتقام، على تحرير والدته من الأسر. وتتصادم "سيلينا" و "سيلفر" على "بروس" عند لقائهما الأول.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Tonight's the Night
episodes.overviewEn: Galavan sends Barbara after Jim Gordon, while he tries to make a business deal with Bruce Wayne. Barnes and Bullock are hot on Barbara's trail, and Nygma has a run-in with a familiar face.
episodes.overviewAr: بعدما تستيقظ "باربرا" من كابوس مفزع تقشعر له الأبدان، يقدّم "غالافان" المتعطش للسلطة لـ "بروس" عرضًا مغريًا للغاية يصعب رفضه.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: A Bitter Pill to Swallow
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Barnes continue cleaning up Gotham, and Gordon comes face-to-face with one of the city's most dangerous hitmen, Eduardo Flamingo. Meanwhile, Nygma and Penguin cross paths again, and Bruce pressures Galavan into handing over the name of his parents' murderer.
episodes.overviewAr: تعبّر "لي" عن قلقها بشأن جانب "غوردون" المظلم، بينما يرعى "إدوارد" "البطريق" المصاب حتى يستعيد عافيته... ويلتمس منه المشورة.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: The Son of Gotham
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon confronts a suspect who is connected to Galavan, but falls short of obtaining any information. Meanwhile, Bruce gets one step closer to discovering the name of his parent's killer.
episodes.overviewAr: تجدد "سيلينا" و"بروس" الشراكة بينهما، بينما يحاول "غوردون" تجديد مسعاه لإبقاء "غالافان" خلف القضبان حيث يستحق أن يكون.

episodes.name: Rise of the Villains: Worse than a Crime
episodes.overviewEn: When Bruce Wayne is kidnapped, Gordon must look to some unlikely and dangerous allies for help. It is a battle of the villains, and not everyone makes it out alive.
episodes.overviewAr: يلجأ "غوردون" إلى حليف غير متوقع لإحباط خطط "غالافان" التي تستهدف الانتقام من آل "وين"، بعد اختطاف "بروس".

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Mr. Freeze
episodes.overviewEn: Penguin takes a hit for Galavan's murder, but doesn't let Gordon off easily. Meanwhile, Gordon and Bullock investigate the body-snatching spree of Victor Fries, one of Gotham's preeminent cryogenics engineers.
episodes.overviewAr: يستعد "غوردون" للإدلاء بشهادة بالغة الأهمية، بينما يظهر عدوّ جديد مخيف في "غوثام" يجمّد ضحاياه حتى الموت.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: A Dead Man Feels No Cold
episodes.overviewEn: As Gordon, Bullock and Barnes continue the search for Victor Fries, they are forced to look to his wife, Nora, for help. Meanwhile, Penguin is introduced to Hugo Strange, and Alfred reveals some crucial information to Bruce about his parents' murderer.
episodes.overviewAr: يشارك "ألفريد" معلومات جديدة عن الرجل الذي قتل والدي "بروس"، بينما تستعد الشرطة لنقل سجين جديد إلى مصحة "أركام".

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: This Ball of Mud and Meanness
episodes.overviewEn: Alfred and Selina help Bruce search for his parents' killer, Matches Malone; Gordon goes to Edward Nygma with Kristen Kringle's whereabouts; Hugo Strange continues working to reduce the Penguin's aggression.
episodes.overviewAr: يتابع "البطريق" عمله مع "هيوغو سترينج" الواثق في أنه يستطيع علاج عدائيته، بينما يجدد "بروس" قسمه بالعثور على قاتل والديه.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Mad Grey Dawn
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock follow a trail of clues in a robbery, not knowing they were left by Nygma; Gordon receives an anonymous threat; Penguin meets his father; Bruce works on his street smarts.
episodes.overviewAr: فيما يحقق "غوردون" و "بولوك" في حادث سطو على متحف، يجتمع "البطريق" مع بعض أصدقائه القدامى، ويختبر "بروس" مهاراته الجديدة وسعة حيلته.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Prisoners
episodes.overviewEn: After Gordon is removed from protective custody, he begin's to face new threat's and danger's inside prison wall's in order to survive he must rely on a new friend as well as Bullock and other outside help. Meanwhile, Penguin grow's closer to his Father, while his step-mother and step-siblings move forward with their own plan's for the family.
episodes.overviewAr: يجرب "غوردون" حياة السجن، وينقل "بولوك" أخبارًا مفجعة. ومن جهة أخرى، يتعامل "البطريق" مع الخلل الذي ضرب عائلته.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Into the Woods
episodes.overviewEn: In an attempt to clear his name, Gordon steals his case file and approaches Nygma for help. Meanwhile, Penguin discovers his step-family's role in his father's death, and awakens from his conditioning.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يعمل "غوردون" اليائس على تبرئة اسمه، يعرف "البطريق" الحقيقة المفاجئة عن موت والده.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Pinewood
episodes.overviewEn: After leaving Arkham Asylum, Barbara attempts to make amends with Gordon. Then, Bruce and Alfred track down one of Thomas Wayne's former friends from Project Chimera, but Hugo Strange disrupts their plans.
episodes.overviewAr: تتواصل "باربرا" مع "غوردون" في محاولة لإصلاح علاقتهما، وينطلق كل من "بروس" و"ألفريد" في رحلة بحث عن أحد زملاء "توماس وين" القدامى.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Azrael
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bruce question Professor Strange about project chimera which leads Strange to send the newly resurrected Galavan to confront Gordon. Meanwhile, Gordon investigate's who Professor Strange is.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يستجوب "غوردون" البروفيسور "سترينج" عن عمله في "مزارع الصنوبر"، يتأهّب شرير جديد للانقضاض على المدينة.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Unleashed
episodes.overviewEn: Azrael is on the loose in Gotham City, which sparks Penguin's need for revenge. Meanwhile, Bruce enlists the help of Selina Kyle to help track down Professor Strange, as he evades arrest for his experiments.
episodes.overviewAr: يدفع تعهُّد "عزرائيل" بقتل "غوردون" إلى ظهور "البطريق" فجأة، لكن لم يطُل الأمر حتى أصبح "بروس" الهدف الجديد.

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: A Legion of Horribles
episodes.overviewEn: Hugo Strange welcomes a familiar face to Gotham after he resurrects Fish Mooney in Indian Hill. Later, Bruce discovers a friend is in danger and teams up with Gordon, Alfred and Lucius, while uncovering more of Strange's experiments.
episodes.overviewAr: بمساعدة "غوردون" و"لوشيوس" و"ألفريد"، ينطلق "بروس" لإنقاذ "سيلينا"، لكن يتعين عليهم أولاً إيجاد المختبر السري للبروفيسور "سترينج".

episodes.name: Wrath of the Villains: Transference
episodes.overviewEn: While Gordon, Bruce and Lucius remain at Indian Hill, the city of Gotham will be met with a new threat as Hugo Strange's inmates devise a plan to escape and start their new lives in Gotham.
episodes.overviewAr: يخضع "غوردون" لعملية تحوّل تحت تأثير المخدرات في معمل البروفيسور "سترينج"، بينما يُلقي خطر جديد بظلاله على مدينة "غوثام".

episodes.name: Mad City: Better to Reign in Hell...
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon works in a monster-ridden Gotham as a bounty hunter and seeks to find answers about the Indian Hill escapees, and why their powers appear to be killing them. Meanwhile, Bruce's doppelganger roams the streets, and Barbara and Tabitha open a new nightclub called The Sirens.
episodes.overviewAr: يجوب "غوردون" شوارع "غوثام" كصائد جوائز، للعثور على العالم الشرير الخارق المجنون "هيوغو سترينج" و"فيش موني" التي أُعيد إحياؤها.

episodes.name: Mad City: Burn the Witch
episodes.overviewEn: Fish Mooney takes matters into her own hands to locate Hugo Strange, forcing Gordon to reluctantly team up with journalist Valerie Vale to find her. Penguin rises in popularity after criticizing the work of the GCPD and Bruce's investigation of the Court of Owls is compromised. Meanwhile, Ivy Pepper is reintroduced into Gotham city.
episodes.overviewAr: مازال البروفيسور "سترينج" حُرًا، بينما تسعى "فيش" جاهدة لإيجاده. ويعقد "غوردون" والصحفية "فاليري فايل" العزم على إيجاد "فيش".

episodes.name: Mad City: Look Into My Eyes
episodes.overviewEn: Hypnotist Jervis Tetch/Mad Hatter arrives in Gotham to search for his sister, Alice, and hires Gordon to help find her. Meanwhile, Penguin decides to run for mayor and Bruce's doppelganger begins to channel him, causing some confusion around town.
episodes.overviewAr: يساعد "غوردون" الوافد الجديد "جيرفيس تيتش" المعروف بـ "ماد هاتر" على إيجاد أخته المفقودة "آليس"، بينما يستعد "البطريق" لخوض الانتخابات.

episodes.name: Mad City: New Day Rising
episodes.overviewEn: Penguin gains power as he narrows in on the nomination for Mayor of Gotham. Meanwhile, Gordon turns Alice into the GCPD for the bounty. Also, Bruce and Alfred race to find Bruce's doppelganger after learning he's assumed Bruce's identity.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يتأهب "البطريق" ليصبح عمدة مدينة "غوثام"، ينقِّب "بروس" و"ألفريد" عن شبيه "بروس" الذي ينتحل شخصيته.

episodes.name: Mad City: Anything for You
episodes.overviewEn: Crime in Gotham is at an all-time high, as Penguin struggles to uphold his promises to the city. Meanwhile, Butch goes down a dark path with the infamous Red Hood Gang and Bruce begins to investigate Ivy's whereabouts.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يبحث "بروس" عن "آيفي"، يجد العمدة المنتخب حديثًا "كوبلبوت" نفسه أمام كمّ هائل من الوعود الانتخابية لحملته، ومعدلات جريمة غير مسبوقة.

episodes.name: Mad City: Follow the White Rabbit
episodes.overviewEn: Mad Hatter sets his eyes on his next victims, forcing Jim Gordon to make some tough decisions. Meanwhile, Penguin and Nygma's relationship evolves, and a familiar face comes back into Nygma's life.
episodes.overviewAr: يُرغِم السادي "ماد هاتر" "غوردون" على اتخاذ قرارٍ شبه مستحيل، ويجتمع "إدوارد "إد" نيغما"، المُحِب للألغاز، مع وجه مألوف.

episodes.name: Mad City: Red Queen
episodes.overviewEn: After coming in contact with a substance by the hand of Mad Hatter, Jim Gordon gets led on a psychedelic trip and must confront his past, present and future. Meanwhile, Penguin struggles with Nygma's new relationship.
episodes.overviewAr: جدال مع "ماد هاتر" يُدخِل "غوردون" في دوامة من عقاقير الهلوسة، بينما يجد "البطريق" صعوبة في تقبُّل طبيعة علاقة "نيغما" الجديدة.

episodes.name: Mad City: Blood Rush
episodes.overviewEn: The effects of a recent incident begin to cause Barnes to go mad; Nygma is over his head in his relationship with Isabella; Carmine Falcone throws an engagement party for Lee and Mario.
episodes.overviewAr: يجنّ جنون "بارنز" بسبب إصابته الشديدة بالفيروس، بينما يتحسّس "نيغما" علاقته مع "إيزابيلا"، ويقيم "فالكون" حفل خِطبة لـ "ماريو" و"لي".

episodes.name: Mad City: The Executioner
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock sift through evidence from the murder at Lee and Mario's engagement party; Ivy discloses her identity to Selina and Bruce.
episodes.overviewAr: يحثّ "غوردون" "بولوك" على التحقيق مع "بارنز"، ويلجأ "نيغما" إلى "البطريق" فور علمه بخبر سيئ. وتبوح "آيفي" بأسرارها لكل من "بروس" و"سيلينا".

episodes.name: Mad City: Time Bomb
episodes.overviewEn: On the eve of their rehearsal dinner, a threat to Mario and Lee is exposed, and Falcone looks to Jim for help. Meanwhile, Nygma seeks revenge and Bruce learns more about The Court of Owls.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يطفو على السطح تهديد جديد أثناء التحضير لحفل زفاف "ماريو" و"لي"، يبدأ "بروس" في كشف أسرار "محكمة البوم".

episodes.name: Mad City: Beware the Green-Eyed Monster
episodes.overviewEn: As the virus begins to spread in Gotham, the laboratory that is developing a cure is compromised. Mario and Gordon face off before the wedding, Selina meets an unexpected face and Barbara comes to Nygma with information about Isabella.
episodes.overviewAr: ينتشر الفيروس في أرجاء المدينة، ويتعرّض مختبر "غوثام" الذي يستحدث علاجًا للفيروس للتهديد، ويتواجه "غوردون" و"ماريو" قبل الزفاف.

episodes.name: Mad City: Ghosts
episodes.overviewEn: Falcone places a hit on Gordon after learning that he shot Mario. Gordon and Bullock discover a follower of Jerome, who plans to bring him back to life. Meanwhile, Penguin spirals out of control before the biggest television interview of his Mayoral career, and Bruce and Selina deal with Selina's mom's return to Gotham.
episodes.overviewAr: يكتشف "غوردون" و"بولوك" خططًا سرية تعيد إحياء عدو قديم، وتعود والدة "سيلينا" إلى مدينة "غوثام"، بينما يستعدّ "البطريق" لمقابلة تلفزيونية.

episodes.name: Mad City: Smile Like You Mean It
episodes.overviewEn: On the run from Gordon and Bullock, Dwight tries to revive Jerome, in turn, activates his acolytes around Gotham City. Meanwhile, Selina's mom's intentions in Gotham are revealed, and the power play between Penguin and Nygma escalates as Barbara's plans are set in place.
episodes.overviewAr: يُثير قرار "دوايت" إحياء "جيروم" جنون أتباعه، بينما يحتدم الصراع على السلطة بين "نيغما" و"البطريق".

episodes.name: Mad City: The Gentle Art of Making Enemies
episodes.overviewEn: With Jerome on the loose with one target in mind, Bruce and Alfred's safety is compromised. Meanwhile, Gordon's uncle Frank pays him a visit, and Nygma and Penguin are forced to confront their issues face-to-face, with possible deadly consequences.
episodes.overviewAr: يستهدف "جيروم" "بروس"، ويُفاجَأ "غوردون" بزيارة عمّه له، بينما يواجه "البطريق" و"نيغما" مشاكلهما.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: How the Riddler Got His Name
episodes.overviewEn: Nygma convinces himself that he doesn't need Penguin to succeed and begins to introduce himself to Gotham as "The Riddler." Bullock and Lucius Fox get caught up in Nygma's mind games, while Gordon learns troubling news about his father's death. Meanwhile, the Court of the Owls reveals its next move.
episodes.overviewAr: يظهر شرير آخر في "غوثام" مع تحوّل "نيغما" إلى "ريدلر"، وتتكشف تفاصيل خطيرة عن حقيقة وفاة والد "غوردون".

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: These Delicate and Dark Obsessions
episodes.nameAr: يا لها من هواجس حسّاسة وغامضة
episodes.overviewEn: The Court of Owls devises a new plan regarding the future of Gotham, as Gordon uncovers information about his father and uncle's past, connecting him back to the organization. Meanwhile, Bruce wakes up in the temple and learns of the Shaman's wish for him.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يُهدد سلاح فتّاك المدينة بأكملها، يبدأ "بروس" دروسه مع "المشعوذ"، بينما يكتشف "غوردون" روابطًا في نسب عائلته تثير دهشته.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: The Primal Riddle
episodes.overviewEn: Some of Gotham's most unhinged villains band together, while The Riddler continues his conquest of the city. Gordon is on a search for answers and all roads keep leading him back to the Court of Owls. Meanwhile, as Alfred begins to notice a change in Bruce, Bruce 2 confides in Selina.
episodes.overviewAr: تستشعر مدينة "غوثام" خطرًا محدقًا عندما يتّحد بعضٌ من أعتى أشرارها، بمن فيهم السيد "فريز"، لتشكيل قوة هائلة.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Light the Wick
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon tracks down the weapon the Court of Owls intend to use for the destruction of Gotham; Kathryn and Temple Shaman tell Bruce about their next move; Ivy offers Selina help.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما تتكشف حقائق مرعبة، يحاول "غوردون" إقناع "كاثرين" بالحصول على مقعد في مجلس "محكمة البوم". وفي الوقت نفسه، يُكثّف "بروس" تدريباته.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: All Will Be Judged
episodes.overviewEn: Temple Shaman takes Bruce to the next phase of his training; Gordon and Bullock discover a crystal owl that carries the biggest secrets of Gotham's underworld; Nygma and Penguin must work together to get out of a tricky situation.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يكشف "المشعوذ" عن نواياه، يتسبب اكتشاف مثير في كشف أسرار عالم مدينة "غوثام" السفلي، ويتحتّم على "البطريق" و"ريدلر" العمل معًا.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Pretty Hate Machine
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon races against the clock to save the city from the Alice Tetch Virus, when Lee Thompkins intercepts with a plan of her own. Also, Alfred sees a big change in Bruce Wayne after his work with The Shaman. Meanwhile, some of Gotham's most deranged villains band together.
episodes.overviewAr: يتحد أعتى شريري المدينة، بينما يجتاح فيروس مميت مدينة "غوثام"، ويتأهّب الشاب "بروس" لتقبُّل مصيره.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Destiny Calling
episodes.overviewEn: With the deadly virus spreading throughout the city, the search for the antidote continues, as Fish Mooney, The Riddler and Penguin reveal plans of their own. Bruce meets Ra's al Ghul and completes his last task in order to fulfill his destiny, but realizes he can't let go of his past. Meanwhile, Gordon tries to win back Lee, and past alliances within Gotham City are broken, while new alliances are formed.
episodes.overviewAr: يُكثَّف البحث عن ترياق، بينما يعم الظلام فوق "غوثام". ويضع ثلاثة أشرار مخططاتهم، ويجد "بروس" صعوبة في تجاوز ماضيه.

episodes.name: Heroes Rise: Heavydirtysoul
episodes.overviewEn: With the deadly virus spreading throughout the city, the search for the antidote continues, as Fish Mooney, The Riddler and Penguin reveal plans of their own. Bruce meets Ra's al Ghul and completes his last task in order to fulfill his destiny, but realizes he can't let go of his past. Meanwhile, Gordon tries to win back Lee, and past alliances within Gotham City are broken, while new alliances are formed.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Pax Penguina
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon fears Jonathan Crane is still alive and back in Gotham, when The Scarecrow's signature MO is used in a series of robberies. Meanwhile, Penguin's "licensing" of crime in the city backfires during the grand opening of his new Iceberg Lounge. Also, in the aftermath of his encounter with Ra's Al Ghul, Bruce begins his vigilante watch.
episodes.overviewAr: فيما يتأقلم "بروس" على حياته كحارس للقانون، يخطط "البطريق" لافتتاح كبير لـ"آيسبيرغ لاونج". ويجبر شرير جديد مدينة "غوثام" على مواجهة مخاوفها.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Fear Reaper
episodes.overviewEn: Under pressure to prove that the GCPD is still powerful, Gordon attempts to bring in Jonathan Crane. However, Gordon puts himself in a dangerous situation at Arkham when he is forced to fight off lunatics and the demon within himself. Meanwhile, with Barbara's unexpected return, Selina and Tabitha must consider risks that come with joining her in the weapon business.
episodes.overviewAr: يحشد "الفزّاعة" جيشًا، ويُطلق "البطريق" تحديًا عامًا لـ"غوردون" للعثور على "جوناثان كراين"، وتتفاوض "سيلينا" و"تابيثا" على شراكتهما الجديدة.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: They Who Hide Behind Masks
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon takes matters into his own hands when he travels to Miami in attempts to persuade Carmine Falcone for his help in the fight against Penguin. There, he meets Carmine's daughter, Sofia, who unexpectedly follows Gordon back to Gotham. The battle for Penguin's prized weaponry continues during auction night at the Iceberg Lounge and Bruce's presence puts him on Penguin's radar.
episodes.overviewAr: يذهب "غوردون" إلى "فالكون" طلبًا لمساعدته، ويرتدي "بروس" عدة أزياء تنكّريّة، فيما تُلحق سرقة في "آيسبيرغ لاونج" ضررًا بالغًا بـ"البطريق".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Demon's Head
episodes.overviewEn: Bruce Wayne puts the lives of Gotham Natural History Museum historian Niles Winthrop and his grandson, Alex, in danger in an attempt to uncover the meaning behind his prized knife from the auction. Meanwhile, Ra's Al Ghul proves he'll take deadly measures to achieve what he wants. Also, with Sofia Falcone in town, she is on a mission to win back Gotham from Penguin.
episodes.overviewAr: يتعرّض "بروس" و"ألفريد" للخطر في بحثهما عن أصول السكّين القديمة. وفي الوقت نفسه، يرغب "نيغما" بالثأر، ولكن يبدو أنّه فقد مهارته.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Blade's Path
episodes.overviewEn: Nygma comes face-to-face with Butch Gilzean, but he is not who he used to be. In an attempt to regain power and identity, Nygma decides to put his former partner's skills to the test. Meanwhile, Sofia Falcone takes action to protect her own life by appealing to Penguin's vulnerable side. With the power of the dagger in his possession, Bruce surprises those around him with his bold actions.
episodes.overviewAr: يتولّى "بروس" الأمور بنفسه، ويواجه "نيغما" أحد شركائه القدامى، فيما تستجدي "صوفيا" الجانب اللين من شخصية "البطريق".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Hog Day Afternoon
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock are hot on a serial killer who has been assassinating cops and dressing his victims in the severed heads of pigs as his signature mark. Meanwhile, Sofia tries to win over Penguin, and Thompkins, Nygma and Grundy find themselves an unlikely home at Cherry's place.
episodes.overviewAr: يضرب قاتل جديد مدينة "غوثام" بأسلوب مُقلق، إذ يقتل رجال الشرطة ويتوّج ضحاياه برأس خنزير مذبوح، فيما ينضمّ "غراندي" إلى القتال.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: A Day in the Narrows
episodes.overviewEn: With Professor Pyg striking fear throughout Gotham, Gordon and Bullock head into the Narrows to look for clues. Bruce Wayne meets a former friend, Grace, who convinces him to come along for a night out with some old classmates. Meanwhile, Sofia's relationships with Penguin and Gordon continue to evolve.
episodes.overviewAr: يدفع توصيل طرود إلى قسم الشرطة "البطريق" إلى تقديم خدماته، فيما تُقنع صديقة قديمة "بروس" بلقاء بعض زملاء الدراسة السابقين.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Stop Hitting Yourself
episodes.overviewEn: Grundy and Nygma become main attractions at Cherry's Place in The Narrows. Penguin wants revenge when he hears Nygma is mocking him on stage and enlists The Sirens for help. Meanwhile, Gordon is offered the position of GCPD Captain, putting him at odds with Bullock.
episodes.overviewAr: يرسل "البطريق" الساعي للثأر الـ"سايرنز" وراء "نيغما" حين يسمع بأنّه يسخر منه علانية، وتقف ترقية كبيرة بين "غوردون" و"بولوك".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Let Them Eat Pie
episodes.overviewEn: Professor Pyg continues to torment Gotham city, involving Jim Gordon whenever possible. Sofia and Penguin get ready for a fundraiser for the orphanage, and things don't go as planned when Professor Pyg shows up as the chef. Meanwhile, Bruce's partying gets in the way of his relationship with Alfred.
episodes.overviewAr: فيما تخطّط "صوفيا" لحفل جمع تبرعات أنيق لمدرسة الأيتام، يعطي البروفيسور "بايغ" عينةً مما سيفعله مستقبلًا، ويذهب "بروس" و"ألفريد" إلى الغابة.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Things That Go Boom
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon tries to broker a deal with Penguin that involves Sofia. Meanwhile, Alfred tries to pull Bruce out of his teenage-angst and downward spiral, as Lee Thompkins gains more control over the Narrows.
episodes.overviewAr: يبحث "غوردون" في ماضي "بايغ" مُحاولًا كشفه، بينما تُحكم "لي" سيطرتها على "ناروز"، ويصبّ "البطريق" المُحتَقر غضبه على "صوفيا".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Queen Takes Knight
episodes.overviewEn: Things get complicated for Gordon, Sophia and Penguin when Carmine Falcone comes to town. Alfred tries to get through to Bruce once and for all, while Nygma struggles to gain control over The Riddler persona and Tabitha attempts to make Grundy remember his past.
episodes.overviewAr: تُسفر خطة "البطريق" باستدعاء صديق قديم إلى مدينة "غوثام" عن عنف غير متوقّع، فيما يتشاجر "بروس" و"ألفريد" حول سلوكٍ سيّئ.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Pieces of a Broken Mirror
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon is called to the scene after The Toy Maker is hired to assassinate one of Gotham's doctors. Lee Thompkins begins to try to rebuild the Narrows, with Nygma as her partner. Meanwhile, Alfred's new life in the Narrows becomes quite complicated. Ivy reveals her new persona to Selina, with some sinister plans in mind.
episodes.overviewAr: تضرب شخصيّة جديدة نابضة بالحياة جذورها في "غوثام"، ويتأقلم "ألفريد" مع حياته بعيدًا عن شركة "واين" ويدعم "نيغما" "لي" في إعادة بناء "ناروز".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: A Beautiful Darkness
episodes.overviewEn: Ivy tracks a secret project on which Wayne Enterprises is working and begins to target anyone that can give her information. Meanwhile, Jerome becomes obsessed with Penguin in Arkham. Also, Gordon begins to second guess his deal with Sofia and an unsettling dream sequence shakes up Bruce.
episodes.overviewAr: تستخدم "آيفي" مادة مُسمّمة للقضاء على أهدافها وهي تحاول الكشف عن مشروع سرّيّ للغاية، ويسخر "جيروم" من "البطريق"، ويرى "بروس" مستقبله.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Reunion
episodes.overviewEn: Ivy picks her next target, leading Gordon and Lucius back to an old friend, as Selina tries to take matters into her own hands. Sofia wants full control of Gotham and turns to Lee about the state of the Narrows. Meanwhile, Bruce tries to make amends with Alfred, and Nygma visits Arkham.
episodes.overviewAr: تفرض "صوفيا" مطالب باهظة على "ناروز"، ويتواصل "بروس" النادم مع "ألفريد"، وتفوح رائحة الانتقام من هجوم واسع النطاق على مدينة "غوثام".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: The Sinking Ship, the Grand Applause
episodes.overviewEn: Bullock and Gordon try to track down someone who is key in Sofia's control over Gotham. Meanwhile, Penguin, Lee and Nygma enlist an unlikely ally as they seek revenge, and Selina asks Bruce for a favor to help rid her of her guilt over Ivy.
episodes.overviewAr: فيما يبحث "غوردون" و"بولوك" عن شاهد رئيسيّ للقضاء على "صوفيا"، تذهب "لي" إلى "البطريق" و"نيغما" بخطّة للثأر، وتطلب "سيلينا" مساعدة "بروس".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: One of My Three Soups
episodes.overviewEn: Arkham's "finest" give Gordon and Bullock a run for their money, as they hatch a plan to escape the asylum. Meanwhile, Bruce devises his own strategy to thwart their plans. Also, Barbara gets an offer she can't refuse.
episodes.overviewAr: يُسفر هروب منسّق من مصحّة "أركام" عن انتشار الفوضى والدم في الشوارع، ويطارد "بروس" عدوًا قديمًا، فيما تكشف ذكريات أليمة عن هدف "باربرا".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: Mandatory Brunch Meeting
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock try to stay one step ahead as Jerome zeros in on his next target. Meanwhile, Nygma hosts a riddle game show in the Narrows and faces his toughest challenger in Lee Thompkins, and Penguin goes to see Butch with a proposal.
episodes.overviewAr: يدعو "جيروم" إلى اجتماع "فرقة المروّعين" الأوّل، ويستضيف "نيغما" برنامج ألعاب في "ناروز"، بينما يقدّم "البطريق" عرضًا إلى "بوتش".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: That's Entertainment
episodes.overviewEn: The Arkham inmates are still running freely in Gotham and they're only getting more difficult to catch. Gordon develops a plan, but reluctantly has to turn to Bruce for help. Meanwhile, Barbara finds out just how far her new friends are willing to go for her.
episodes.overviewAr: يذهب "غوردون" إلى "بروس" بخطة حين يُعلن "جيروم" مطالبه من مدينة "غوثام"، بينما يتردّد "البطريق"، وتكشف "باربرا" عن مصيرها.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: To Our Deaths and Beyond
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock try to figure out who the clever thief is behind the robberies of various bank branches in Gotham. Meanwhile, Barbara is put in danger, forcing Tabitha to recruit help.
episodes.overviewAr: يشغل تفشّي سرقات البنوك "غوردون" و"بولوك"، بينما يصحو شرّ مألوف مجدّدًا معرّضًا "باربرا" للخطر، ومجبرًا "سيلينا" على التحيّز لأحد الأطراف.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: That Old Corpse
episodes.overviewEn: Chaos erupts at the GCPD, sending Gordon on a wild goose chase for the culprit behind the mass takeover. Meanwhile, a friend of Bruce's becomes paranoid, resulting in rash and destructive behavior.
episodes.overviewAr: تعمُّ الفوضى حين يحتشد أتباع "جيروم" حول قسم شرطة "غوثام" ويتحرّك "نيغما" ليحرّر "لي"، ويبني "بروس" علاقة ثقة مع "جيريماي".

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: One Bad Day
episodes.overviewEn: As Gotham falls into complete anarchy, a team of unlikely heroes step up to save it. Bullock takes the lead at the GCPD and Bruce's psychological limits are tested as those close to him are put in danger.
episodes.overviewAr: يتدخّل "بولوك" لإيقاف مخطّط متفجّر بمساعدة أكثر أبطال المدينة استبعادًا، ويستجيب "بروس" لنداء محتوم يثير أسوأ مخاوفه.

episodes.name: A Dark Knight: No Man's Land
episodes.overviewEn: Jeremiah warns a skeptical Gordon of more destruction coming Gotham's way, and Gordon is forced to make a potentially devastating decision. Meanwhile, Barbara rallies together a team to secure her position, as alliances in the underworld shift and prove no one can be trusted. Then, Bruce is forced to come to terms with the future.
episodes.overviewAr: تتحقّق رؤية "رأس الغول" السوداء حيث يعلن الحاكم حالة الطوارئ، ويستدرج "جيريماي" "بروس" إلى فخّ، ولكنّ "باربرا" مستعدّة للقتال.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Year Zero
episodes.overviewEn: No Man's Land Day 87-391—Jim Gordon and Bruce Wayne face the chaos Gotham City has become. Their mission to keep the city safe becomes more complicated as the villains who survived the attack on the city begin to resurface and claim various territories. Selina Kyle grapples with how to deal with her uncertain future.
episodes.overviewAr: يطالب الأشرار القدامى بمدينة "غوثام" التي تعمّها الفوضى، ويناضل "غوردون" و"بروس" للحفاظ عليها آمنة. وتواجه "سيلينا" مستقبلًا غامضًا.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Trespassers
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Bullock investigate a location where several kids have been kidnapped. Barbara proves to be an unlikely ally to Gordon. Bruce looks into an alleged witch with healing powers for Selina. Nygma deals with demons of his own.
episodes.overviewAr: يبحث "بروس" عن الساحرة المزعومة، ويتابع "غوردون" و"بولوك" التقدم نحو مصنع يعج بالأطفال المفقودين. وعلى صعيد آخر، يتعامل "نيغما" مع الشياطين.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Penguin, Our Hero
episodes.overviewEn: With the creation of Haven as a safe place for refugees, Gordon hopes to stop the gang fighting in Gotham. Selina is determined to find Jeremiah and she convinces Bruce to help her. Penguin goes to Haven to reclaim his staff.
episodes.overviewAr: ثمة مكان آمن للاجئين في "غوثام"- إلى أن يأتي "البطريق" لجمع شعبه. وتلجأ "سيلينا" العازمة إلى تجنيد "بروس" لمساعدتها في العثور على "جيريماي".

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Ruin
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon and Penguin are forced to work together and alliances are shaken when Lucius, Nygma and Barbara all have different ideas of the culprit behind recent events at Haven. Selina continues her quest for revenge against Jeremiah.
episodes.overviewAr: في أعقاب الهجوم الانفجاري، يعرض "البطريق" مساعدته على "غوردون"، ويعقد "لوشيوس" و"نيغما" اتفاقًا. وفي الوقت نفسه، تضيّق "سيلينا" نطاق بحثها.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Pena Dura
episodes.overviewEn: A military task force, led by Eduardo Dorrance is called in to provide relief to Gotham. Meanwhile, Nygma looks for answers from Penguin, who leads him back to Hugo Strange. Then, Bruce is concerned about Selina's recent behavior.
episodes.overviewAr: تصل فرقة عسكرية إلى "غوثام" للمساعدة في استعادة النظام، ويقود بحث "نيغما" عن الإجابات إلى "البطريق"، وإلى لمّ شمله مع "هيوغو سترينج".

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: 13 Stitches
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon assembles an unlikely team to protect Gotham from Eduardo Dorrance and his Delta Force. Just as Lee Thompkins resurfaces, Barbara reveals shocking news that will change Gordon's life forever. Meanwhile, Selina and Penguin team up to outsmart fellow villain Magpie.
episodes.overviewAr: إنها حرب تحالفات غير محتملة حيث يشكّل "غوردون" فريقًا لاستعادة "غوثام". ويُبقي شرير جديد ماكر "البطريق" و"سيلينا" على أهبة الاستعداد.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Ace Chemicals
episodes.overviewEn: Gordon races to uncover the criminal element threatening to end talks of Gotham's reunification with the mainland. A very much alive Jeremiah returns and organizes a twisted recreation of the murder of Bruce's parents with the help of Jervis Tetch aka Mad Hatter.
episodes.overviewAr: يتسابق "غوردون " لكشف العنصر الإجرامي الذي يهدّد إعادة توحيد "غوثام"، بينما يعود شرير مألوف بمساعدة من "ماد هاتر".

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: Nothing's Shocking
episodes.overviewEn: Bullock's past comes back to haunt him when he and Gordon investigate two murders at Sirens. Meanwhile, Bruce and Alfred explore the tunnels beneath the city, and Penguin and Nygma's plans to escape are thwarted by the least likely of suspects.
episodes.overviewAr: يربط شرير، متغيّر الشكل ويستهدف ضباط شرطة "غوثام"، بين "بولوك" والأشباح من ماضيه. ويغوص "بروس" و"ألفريد" لاستكشاف مجاري المدينة.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: The Trial of Jim Gordon
episodes.overviewEn: After Gordon is shot in an attempt to establish a cease-fire, he hallucinates a trial for his life that could have deadly real consequences. Meanwhile, Ivy returns and puts her spell on Bruce, leaving Selina to defend herself. Lee has a life-changing moment as Barbara and Penguin consider their next moves.
episodes.overviewAr: يغرق "غوردون" المُصاب في سكرات محمومة من الأحلام حيث يُحاكم بسبب سلسلة من الإخفاقات. وفي الوقت الحاضر، تعود "آيفي" وتضع "بروس" نصب عينيها.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: I Am Bane
episodes.overviewEn: On the precipice of Gotham's reunification, Gordon and Bruce find themselves face-to-face with a newly transformed Eduardo, and discover the real mastermind behind the city's current chaos. Meanwhile, a pregnant Barbara turns to Lee for help.
episodes.overviewAr: يتواجه "بروس" و"غوردون" مع "إدواردو"، الذي يخضع لعملية تحوّل كبيرة. وتستعين "باربرا" الحامل بـ"لي" للحصول على المساعدة.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: They Did What?
episodes.overviewEn: As Bane enacts his final plan for Gotham's destruction, Gordon rallies his former enemies to save the city. Meanwhile, Nyssa al Ghul kidnaps Barbara's newborn daughter, with ambitions to raise her as her own. Then, Bruce's decision to leave Gotham points him to his destiny, while devastating Selina.
episodes.overviewAr: بينما يُحكم "باين" و"نيسا" قبضتهما على المدينة، يلجأ "غوردون" إلى أعدائه السابقين للمساعدة في إنقاذها. ويوجّه قرارٌ كبير "بروس" صوب مصيره.

episodes.name: Legend of Dark Knight: The Beginning...
episodes.overviewEn: The series flash-forwards 10 years into the future, as Bruce is set to return to Gotham for the opening of the new Wayne Tower. A series of crimes leads Gordon to believe Penguin and The Riddler are up to their old tricks. However, when Bullock is framed for a murder, Gordon begins to piece together an even more sinister plot targeting the city, and a new figure emerges from the shadows to be the hero Gotham desperately needs.
episodes.overviewAr: بعد عقد من مغادرته "غوثام"، يعود "بروس" إلى افتتاح برج "واين" الجديد ليجدها مدينة بحاجة إلى فارس يُخرجها من الظلام إلى النور.
